scope: Japan medical discovery — Tohoku University School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Tohoku University School of Medicine states that its undergraduate classes are all conducted in Japanese, that no undergraduate courses are offered in English, and that strong Japanese ability is required.
Tohoku University's admissions centre states that privately financed international undergraduates take the same classes as Japanese students and therefore need high Japanese-language proficiency.

Tohoku University's 2026 international-student leaflet lists undergraduate application fee of JPY 17,000, admission fee of JPY 282,000, and annual tuition of JPY 900,000 for international students requiring a student visa.
Tohoku University's undergraduate admissions page for Medicine reports a Ministry of Education-approved increase in the programme's admission capacity.

holdReasons: A current, complete Medicine-specific undergraduate admission requirements set was not assembled from primary sources.
Programme curriculum, clinical-training, recognition and student-support evidence remains incomplete for the required publication fields.
nextAction: Collect current Medicine-specific undergraduate admissions, curriculum, clinical-training, recognition and support documentation, then complete the field-level review before publishing.
